about_the_game:
The Awakener: Battle Tendency

The Awakener: Battle Tendency is an action RPG that blends survivor-style gameplay with high-density hack-and-slash combat and Roguelite progression. Take control of Awakeners from different eras in a third-person perspective, fighting across shifting illusionary battlefields. Stand against the echoes of fate—and seek a way to defeat the Corrosion King, the demonic overlord who spreads through the cracks of reality.

· Reconstructed Realms & Illusory Battles

Summoned by the Goddess of Fate, four “Temporal Remnants” from different eras are drawn into the Realm of Mirrors, a sealed battleground formed from failed histories and fractured destinies. Demonic corruption reshapes the world into ever-changing illusionary dungeons. Battle through shifting zones, escort rituals, siege strongholds, and survive until the ultimate boss trial.

· Awakeners & Destiny Powers

Each Awakener carries the burden of past defeat—and now a chance to rewrite fate. Unlock unique skills, passive branches, and divine awakenings. Unleash Fate Surge, a high-impact combat state that turns the tide in critical moments.

· Diverse Dungeons & Replay Value

Each run generates unique dungeon structures influenced by the “Echo of Fate.” Face a variety of challenges including extermination, time-limited raids, escort missions, and stealth infiltrations. Master both strategy and reflexes to overcome dynamic threats.

· The Law of Battle Tendency

Combat here obeys the Law of Battle Tendency, a metaphysical force that alters conditions mid-fight—enhancing enemies, reviving bosses, mutating resources. Use randomly offered Echo Blessings or resist Curses of Fate to gain a decisive edge.

· Local Co-op & Combat Synergy

The game supports local split-screen co-op for two players. Team up to share skills, loot, and survive together. Master combo strikes, synchronized Awakener abilities, and adaptive positioning to thrive in the chaos of large-scale battles.

short_description: The Awakener: Battle Tendency is a hack-and-slash survivor game that blends Eastern fantasy with Western high fantasy. You will control “Awakeners” from different eras and regions to fight against demonic echoes and twisted fate, striving to rewrite a destiny once doomed to fail.
